description: Given a relation R, a step function g with R(x,g(x)) for every x, and a starting point x_0, there exists a sequence f with f(0) = x_0, f(n+1) = g(f(n)), and R(f(n),f(n+1)) for every natural number n.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.sequence_of_step_function.{u} {α : Type u} (R : α → α → Prop) (g : α → α)
  (hg : ∀ (x : α), R x (g x)) (x₀ : α) :
  ∃ f, f 0 = x₀ ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ), f (n + 1) = g (f n)) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), R (f n) (f (n + 1))
